backend/main.mo: Main actor defining SemenStraw and Sale types with CRUD operations including addOrUpdateStraw, updateStrawStatus, createSale (which decrements quantity and auto-updates status), and query functions for retrieving straws and sales.
backend/migration.mo: Migration module that transforms OldSemenStraw records (without quantity field) to NewSemenStraw records (with quantity defaulting to 1), and initializes empty sales map and nextSaleId counter.
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence report documenting five implemented features: quantity input in add/edit forms, quantity display in inventory table, sell/sale functionality with buyer details, and sell action button in inventory table.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: JSON-formatted summaries of 12 frontend files covering routing, layout, dashboard, inventory table with sell buttons, add/edit forms with quantity fields, sale dialog, sales history page, query hooks, and styling configuration.
frontend/index.css: Tailwind CSS configuration with agricultural-themed OKLCH color palette defining CSS custom properties for light and dark modes with earthy tones (greens, browns, creams).
frontend/index.html: HTML entry point with root div and module script reference to main.tsx for the Semen Straw Business App.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Root application component configuring TanStack Router with Dashboard (/) and SalesHistory (/sales) routes, QueryClientProvider with 5-minute stale time, and Toaster for notifications.
frontend/src/components/AddStrawForm.tsx: Form component for adding new semen straws with fields for strawId, bullId, collectionDate, quality, storageLocation, and quantity (validated as positive integer); calls useAddStraw mutation and resets on success.
frontend/src/components/EditStrawForm.ts: Form component for editing existing semen straws with all fields including quantity (validated as non-negative integer); updates both straw details via useUpdateStraw and status via useUpdateStrawStatus if changed.
frontend/src/components/InventoryFilters: A filter component for inventory that provides a search input for Bull ID/Straw ID and a dropdown to filter by status (All, Available, Sold, Used).
frontend/src/components/InventoryTable.t: Displays a table of semen straws with columns for ID, bull ID, collection date, quality, storage location, quantity, and status, with edit and sell action buttons for each row.
frontend/src/components/Layout.tsx: Main layout component with header navigation (Dashboard/Sales History links), footer with branding, and an outlet for nested routes.
frontend/src/components/SaleDialog.tsx: A form dialog for recording sales of semen straws, capturing sale date, buyer information, quantity sold, and sale price with validation.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: Custom hook that creates and manages the backend actor instance based on Internet Identity authentication state, invalidating dependent queries when the actor changes.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Provides Internet Identity authentication context and hooks for login/logout functionality, managing auth client creation and identity state throughout the application.
frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts: Defines React Query hooks for all backend operations including fetching/adding/updating straws, managing straw status, creating sales, and retrieving sales data.
frontend/src/index.css: Defines Tailwind CSS configuration with custom CSS variables for an agricultural-themed color palette supporting both light and dark modes, using OKLCH color space for earthy tones (greens, browns, creams).
frontend/src/main.tsx: Application entry point that sets up React root with QueryClient for data fetching and InternetIdentityProvider for authentication, rendering the main App component.
frontend/src/pages/Dashboard.tsx: Main inventory dashboard page displaying a filterable/searchable table of semen straws with add new straw dialog, using React Query hooks for data fetching and showing loading/error states.
frontend/src/pages/SalesHistory.tsx: Sales history page displaying all recorded semen straw sales in a table format with sale details (ID, date, buyer info, quantity, price), including loading/error states and empty state handling.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Tailwind CSS configuration extending the default theme with custom colors mapped to CSS variables (OKLCH color space), custom animations, border radius variables, and plugins for typography, container queries, and animations.
project_state.json: Project state tracking file documenting completed features for a semen straw inventory management system, including dashboard, forms, filtering, quantity tracking, and sales functionality with pending backend requirements.
